next_problem.reason: Under the context-only rule, no fresh output has a grounding failure (10/10 statements supported, 5/5 grounded) and no abstention error (2/2 correct, 0 missed). The one generation-side problem still measured is format: 3 of 5 fresh first attempts broke a schema cap and needed the retry. Two of the three broke caps that Prompt v2 never states.

next_problem.caveat: Five fresh questions. A clean score on five does not show the absence of grounding or abstention failures. A later batch may change the classification.
